item.title: 6 expert tips for hunting coyotes without using calls
item.description: Too many hunters think the only way to hunt coyotes is with a predator call, and that’s a big mistake. After all, the smartest coyotes have learned to avoid those suspicious noises, making the calls all but useless. And besides, hunters managed to harvest plenty of coyotes long before predator calls ever came along.
